scenario_desc.cool_morning: Harvest at 06:00 in a cool field (22 °C) that warms steadily to 33 °C by 14:00. The typical good-practice day in the Dharmapuri belt.
scenario_desc.hot_afternoon: Batch left in an open yard at 33–38 °C for 6 h waiting for a trader, then 30 °C into the evening.
scenario_desc.heat_spike: 30 °C baseline with a 2 h spike to 42 °C at hour 3 (e.g. under a tarpaulin or in a closed van), then back to 30 °C. 42 °C is below the 45 °C hard threshold.
scenario_desc.reefer_van: 1 h at 30 °C ambient, then loaded into a 12 °C reefer van for 10 h.
scenario_desc.pre_cooled: 30 °C at harvest, pre-cooled to 15 °C within an hour and held at 12 °C for the rest of 12 h.
scenario_desc.pharma_excursion: 5 °C baseline, a 4 h excursion to 15 °C (hours 2–6), then back to 5 °C. Within the 25 °C hard threshold.
scenario_desc.pharma_freeze: 5 °C baseline, a 30-minute dip to −1 °C at hour 2, then back to 5 °C.

rec.title: Where to sell
rec.unavailable: No recommendation yet — sync and try again.
rec.offline_no_cache: Offline — the recommendation will appear once you are connected.

why.no_data: No recommendation has been fetched for this batch yet. Open the batch while online.
why.intro: Each mandi is scored on today's price, how far it is, and how much of the batch would spoil on the way.
why.formula_distance: Road distance = straight-line distance × {{factor}}; travel time = road distance ÷ {{speed}} km/h.
why.formula_feasible: A mandi is reachable only if travel time is under the most-likely remaining shelf life × {{safety}}.
why.formula_spoilage: Spoilage at arrival = shelf life already used + what the trip uses at the transit temperature (value loss is assumed linear).
why.formula_value: Expected value = price per kg × quantity × (1 − spoilage at arrival) − road distance × {{cost}} per km.
why.formula_rank: Reachable mandis are ranked by expected value; the best is recommended, the next two are alternatives.
